components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Naive UI primary action using the site's cinnabar accent.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #A6331F; border-radius: 2px; background: #A6331F; color: #FBF9F4; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #8F2B1A; border-color: #8F2B1A; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9BFA9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Input
components.description: Quiet desktop form field with a paper surface and restrained border.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="搜索" placeholder="搜索知识卡" />
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #C9BFA9; border-radius: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16191C; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #A6331F; outline: 2px solid #F3E4DE; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Flat white content surface separated from the paper canvas by a fine border.
components.html:
学习单元

查看内容与练习进度。
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #DED6C4; border-radius: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16191C; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 17px/1.5 'Source Han Serif SC', serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #3D4348; font: 400 14px/1.8 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif; }

components.name: Top Navigation Item
components.description: Text-led navigation with a cinnabar underline for the active route.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 2px; color: #3D4348; text-decoration: none; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F4F0E6; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9BFA9; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: #16191C; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item.is-active::after { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: 0; left: 14px; height: 2px; background: #A6331F; content: ''; }

components.name: Video Reference
components.description: Source link for a course segment, kept visually distinct from glossary terms.
components.css: .ds-video-reference { color: #3D4348; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(163, 63, 44, .55); text-decoration: none; font: 400 12px/1.6 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-video-reference:hover { color: #A6331F; border-bottom-color: #A6331F; } .ds-video-reference:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9BFA9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiz Error Row
components.description: Per-field error feedback marked by a cinnabar edge and explanatory text.
components.css: .ds-quiz-error { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border-left: 3px solid #A6331F; background: #FFFFFF; color: #A6331F; font: 400 13px/1.7 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-quiz-error strong { font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: 带排盘附录的学术校勘本
narrative.overview: 六爻研习社以温暖纸色和克制的书刊排印呈现《增删卜易》精读与练习。宋体用于章节和古籍内容，黑体用于操作文字，等宽字用于编号、时间与数据。朱砂是当前主要交互强调色，细边框和留白承担页面分组。
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas, dark ink, and fine divider lines.
Serif editorial headings paired with sans-serif controls and mono metadata.
Cinnabar is the primary interaction accent; rounded corners stay at 2px.
Designed and verified for desktop CSS viewports at least 1240px wide.

rules.name: Desktop Scope
rules.body: The supported design target starts at 1240 CSS pixels; mobile and tablet layouts are outside the acceptance scope.

rules.name: Paper and Ink
rules.body: Use the existing paper, white surface, ink, and rule tokens as defined in DESIGN.md; do not reintroduce the retired indigo palette.

dos: Do keep labels and data values compact and align them with mono typography.
Do express status with text, symbols, or borders as well as color.
donts: Don't claim mobile or tablet support.
Don't use decorative ink-wash, scroll, cloud, compass, or bagua watermark imagery.
